title: Certified Verification of Polynomial Master Equations and Critical Solutions in Open Quantum Systems
abstract: Miku Ishizaki and Jaeha Lee (arXiv:2611.33027, Nov 2026) developed a locally deterministic matrix-polynomial formulation of non-Markovian open quantum master equations P(D)E(t) = 0 derived from P(s)(LE)(s) = Q(s), establishing exact order-5 differential equations and critical-parameter order reductions for a coupled two-qubit model, a sharp three-tier singularity/periodicity hierarchy governed by odd/odd rational singular-value ratios, and order-3 polynomial equations exhibiting a non-diagonalizable Jordan exceptional point at lambda = 2 gamma_0 in the unbounded multi-mode Jaynes-Cummings model. We construct a standalone zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 formalization of 18 core polynomial-ring, 4x4/3x3 matrix, singularity, parity-obstruction, and Jordan-nilpotency theorems (zero sorry, zero warnings, zero Classical.choice) paired with an exact-Q four-mode certificate verifier (POLY-MASTER-CERT-1.0). Across 16 canonical certificates (0.046-0.648 ms, total 3.42 ms), all invariants replay identically over Q while rejecting 60/60 live adversarial forgery attacks.
